scope: Exact KiCad pad source arithmetic and placement, combined rounded/chamfered corners, outer-copper layer alias, and typed required marker/net-class boundaries. All 39 properties, 14 targets and crate future work remain in scope.
contract: Exact source decimals precede center/size/delta/ratio/diameter arithmetic and native primitive construction. Present malformed numeric tokens retain source failure; absent optional fields retain their documented defaults. Nonzero source dimensions outside binary64 range stay native.

Pad coordinates are footprint-relative, pad angles are absolute in the board frame, and KiCad positive rotation turns toward negative Y. Selected chamfers preserve rounding on unselected corners. Oval decomposition and custom local-primitive limitations remain explicit.
F&B.Cu expands to the two outer copper layers even on a multilayer board; the complete CPArti board exposed this separate existing bug after the earlier passing suite.

Required copper/drill marker projections return typed uncertainty with STRICT/budget guards. Copper markers also reject retained source-construction failures. Native class windows retain unknown comparisons; class aggregation delays marker projection until a finding requires it. Missing finite broad-phase anchors retain candidates.

These formulas retain exact authored values and source conventions without reproducing KiCad integer-unit rounding. The source oracle checks positions, exact primitive areas and envelopes, not whole-application KiCad equivalence or every downstream DRC heuristic.

early_marker_regression.cause: Eager class marker projection produced six uncertainties instead of the existing single length uncertainty. The implementation now delays projection; the original no-partial-length test is unchanged and passes.

first_oracle.harness_correction: The initial oracle omitted HVP109A string-only net names; corrected in the oracle, without changing production net parsing.
first_oracle.production_correction: Two complete-board CPArti pads used F&B.Cu; expanded to four real-layer features. All original board bytes are preserved.

source_audit.scope: Five sequential fresh processes per library, CPU 0; 19 complete fixed input strings and 50 loader iterations per row. Witness construction and required-marker checks are outside the loader timing. Different answers preclude a speedup claim. RSS and probe bytes only; no allocation-count or library-size optimization claim. Complete board source oracle validates primitive positions, exact areas and envelopes; custom local geometry is excluded.

reports.limitation: Correct source placement and layer mapping change findings. Every unmatched finding and metadata delta is retained. The independent source oracle does not independently validate all readiness heuristics.

push: No push. The complete repository-wide pre-push matrix was not run.
artifact_scope: Correctness capability costs and process RSS/binary bytes; no matched speedup, allocation-count or library-size improvement claim.

drill_source_audit.scope: Exact independent rational/quadratic-surd source positions, diameters and plating for every parsed drill on both full boards, and complete reported clearance-pair multiset at 0.25 mm. Oval/rectangular drills use the existing conservative larger-axis circular proxy; routed-slot geometry remains open.
